summary: Soligenix filed an 8-K reporting its September 17, 2026 annual meeting results. Stockholders elected five directors, approved a board-discretionary reverse stock split at a 1-for-2 to 1-for-20 ratio exercisable within one year, and approved increasing authorized common stock from 75,000,000 to 125,000,000 shares, effective upon Delaware filing that same day. This is a routine meeting-outcome and charter-amendment report, not a special situation; no transaction, stake, or price terms are stated. Watch for the eventual reverse-split ratio and timing announcement.
